items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: He did everything in his power to help me back to music... He was so very kind to me. He went along with me and he finally got me back to jazz.

ctx.x: What is Father Woods' first name?

Father Anthony Woods, S. J., Jesuit. I'm telling you he was something else. When he passed away about 6 or 8 years ago I thought I was going to die myself. I didn't know I was leaning so hard. He did everything in his power to help me back to music and things that were still happening with me in a strange way, all this ESP working. He told me to call him any time and sometimes I called him 4 o'clock in the morning. He and Lorraine Gillespie, they had a ball on the phone when they talked about me. It was so funny,…
